ig_caption:
Your agent is smart. It just knows nothing about your company 🧠

Real test: I ask a model about my (demo) company's refund policy. It has no idea. It knows the internet, not your company.

"Second brain" comes from personal productivity: knowledge outside your head, organised so you can find it again.
For AI agents it's the same idea: your experts' documents, organised so the agent can read them.

On the platform I build at work, every agent gets one.

Part 1/5 of AI Second Brain. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
